pages.title: Alive at the Other End
pages.text: Distinguish a real living catch from a bucket-spawned creature.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Only active fish-item/entity mappings qualify. Not every fish is supported; moving a supported catch in a bucket is a separate option.

pages.title: Catch a living fish
pages.text: An active mapping can replace a fish-item catch with a living entity. Only permitted mappings apply, not all fish and not every attempted spawn.
